title: A part appears only when it is not a core charge AND its on-hand quantity is greater than zero
refs: specs/inventory-value.md Story 2 S2-R1; S2-R2; §3 Key Decisions
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. ZZAUTOTEST parts exist at your active location: a normal part with positive on-hand quantity, and (for the negative side) a core-charge part and a zero-quantity part.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value report scoped to the location.
2. Look for the normal in-stock part.
3. Look for the core-charge part and the zero-quantity part.
custom_expected:
1. The normal, positive-quantity, non-core part appears as one row.
2. Only parts meeting BOTH conditions — not a core charge, and on-hand quantity greater than zero — are listed.
